messages:
taylor_peopleops: FYI — we have an incoming offer for Priya K., hiring for Eng PM role. Manager asked for a comp-band exception and a mid-cycle start date (wants 5/6 instead of 4/15). Need routing and any finance checks. Details below.

sam_recruiter: Candidate accepted verbally, signed intent. Base requested: $185k, target band is B4 (min 160k, max 170k). Manager (jordan_manager) is asking to approve B5 for this hire due to rare skill match + immediate product need. Also asking for $10k relocation.

jordan_manager: Short context — Priya led infra audits at previous company, two-week notice, available 5/6. If we stick to B4 we risk losing her. Can we make an exception this cycle? Happy to take a smaller sign-on instead of bumping base.

alex_finance: Need full comp plan + rationale. If moving to B5, will require VP comp approval + budget sign-off. Relocation needs to come from relocation ADP budget; 10k is doable but need headcount owner to confirm budget code. Who's the owner?

maria_hrbp: Routing checklist: (1) hiring manager justification, (2) market comp data, (3) approvals: manager -> people-ops -> comp-committee (if above band limit) -> finance -> VP. For start date change, confirm payroll cutoff and benefits enrollment window (if start after 5/1 benefits may shift).

taylor_peopleops: I'll kick off the comp-exception form. Sam — can you paste market comps + candidate counter? Also capture whether sign-on can be used in lieu of base increase. I can route to comp-committee after your doc.

sam_recruiter: Pasting quick comps: 
- Candidate target: $185k (ask)
- Role market 90th pct: $180–195k
- Internal peers avg for similar experience: $168k
Candidate is firm on base but flexible on equity. Willing to take sign-on of $15k and smaller base bump if needed.

jordan_manager: If sign-on works, prefer $10k sign-on + $5k relocation (reduce burden on ongoing payroll). Start date still 5/6.

alex_finance: That split (10k sign-on + 5k relocation) is OK with finance contingent on budget code and headcount owner ack. Need to know if we can approve mid-cycle band bump, otherwise sign-on route is easier and requires only manager + people-ops + finance.

hr-bot: Comp exception form submitted by taylor_peopleops: https://hrforms.redwood.internal/comp-exception/AB12345 (auto-ticket #CE-2026-0419). Status: pending comp-committee review.

maria_hrbp: Quick note on benefits: because start date is 5/6, new hire will miss 5/1 payroll cutoff for medical coverage start date; benefits will begin 6/1 if enrolled by 5/15. If manager needs coverage sooner, we can do a short-term accommodation but that needs approval from People Ops leadership.

taylor_peopleops: Thanks. Routing plan: 
1) People Ops ping comp-committee chair (maria_hrbp) for provisional approval on sign-on split.
2) If chair ok, route to finance for budget code and relocation fund approval.
3) VP sign-off only if base > band max.

jordan_manager: Sounds good. I can confirm budget code now: ENG-PROD-23. I approve sign-on $10k + relocation $5k if comp-committee signs off.

alex_finance: Received budget code ENG-PROD-23, tentative hold placed. I'll approve relocation funds after comp-committee OK.

maria_hrbp: I'll put this on comp-committee agenda today. If they approve sign-on split, we can finalize offer by EOD and target start 5/6. If committee asks for more justification, expect 24–48h delay.

hrijk: (reaction :thumbsup:)

taylor_peopleops: Great — keeping thread updated. Sam please attach candidate doc + justification to CE-2026-0419. Once committee approves I'll update offer letter template with sign-on and relocation lines and confirm start date language for benefits.

sam_recruiter: Done — attached market comp doc and candidate email to the form. Ping me if you need extra wording in offer.

maria_hrbp: Comp-committee approved provisional sign-on split 10k + relocation 5k; no base bump beyond B4. Routing complete: people-ops -> finance -> legal for final offer review.

alex_finance: Finance approved funds. Legal, can you expedite review?

taylor_peopleops: Looping in legal separately. Will send final offer for e-sign after legal ok. Targeting to send before close of business today.

sam_recruiter: Great — thanks everyone. Will update candidate and hold 5/6 start in calendar tentatively.

jordan_manager: Appreciate the quick turnaround.

hr-bot: CE-2026-0419 status updated to APPROVED (sign-on + relocation). Next step: Legal review.
